items.quote: we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27
items.statement: Add 15-17 million new customers in FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.
items.statement: Opex to NTI to improve by 25-40 bps in FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.statement: NIM expected to moderate marginally in FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: we continue to guide for 19% to 20%
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: we expect them to remain range bound and well within our long-term guidance
items.statement: GNPA and NNPA to remain range bound and within long-term guidance
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: We foresee gold loan portfolio to probably cross 5-odd percent of total AUM by FY'27.
items.statement: Gold loan portfolio to reach about 5% of AUM by FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: We expect that it should come back to double-digit growth or the company growth momentum between Q2 and Q3 of FY'27.
items.statement: MSME growth to return to double-digit by Q2-Q3FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: We are well on course to cross 5 million loans in a single month as a firm.
items.statement: Cross 5 million loans in a single month during FY27
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: We orchestrate these 4 to deliver an outcome of 4.3% to 4.7% ROA
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: 20% to 22% ROE to investors on a long-term basis
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: we should be as a firm aspiring to grow 2x of what the system growth is
items.statement: Aspire to grow at 2x system growth, to be a top 5-6 lender in 5-7 years
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: the profit growth principally should be higher than balance sheet growth
items.statement: Profit growth to exceed balance sheet growth
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management says it is confident of 20-24% AUM growth and of ROA and ROE guidance, while stating the outlook is contingent on easing geopolitical tensions and macro stability.
